name: deepseek-junior
description: Delegate code work to DeepSeek V4 as a junior developer.
long_description: DeepSeek Junior turns DeepSeek V4 into a junior developer you orchestrate. The host agent (Claude / Codex) writes plans and makes decisions; DeepSeek executes mechanical work — codebase scanning, implementing plan steps, code review. Streams generation progress live via MCP progress notifications.
